verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection-management platform, so a built-in assistant is a plausible feature to ask about and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The docs cover connecting external agents to MCP servers, the CLI, tokens and the registry, which are infrastructure for other agents rather than a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
